en.t: Arbogast has Eugenius elected Western Roman Emperor
en.s: Eugenius (died 6 September 394) was a Western Roman emperor from 392 to 394, unrecognized by the Eastern Roman emperor Theodosius I. While Christian himself, Eugenius capitalized on the discontent in the West caused by Theodosius' religious policies targeting pagans. He renovated the pagan Temple of Venus and Roma and restored the Altar of Victory after continued petitions from the Roman Senate.

zh.t: 阿尔博加斯拥立欧根尼为西罗马皇帝
zh.s: 欧根尼（卒于394年9月6日）于392年至394年担任西罗马皇帝，但未获东罗马皇帝狄奥多西一世承认。欧根尼本人是基督徒，却利用西部地区对狄奥多西针对异教徒的宗教政策不满而扩大影响。他翻修了异教的维纳斯与罗马神庙，并在罗马元老院持续请愿后恢复胜利祭坛。

en.s: The Battle of Jengland (also called Jengland-Beslé, Beslé, or Grand Fougeray) took place on 22 August 851, between the West Frankish army of Charles the Bald and the Breton army of Erispoe, Duke of Brittany. The Bretons were victorious, leading to the signing of the Treaty of Angers in September 851 and the recognition of Erispoe as the legitimate ruler of the Bretons under Charles.

zh.s: 851年8月22日，秃头查理率领的西法兰克军队与布列塔尼公爵埃里斯波埃率领的布列塔尼军队在让格朗交战。布列塔尼军获胜，促成双方于851年9月签署昂热条约，并使埃里斯波埃获查理承认为布列塔尼的合法统治者。该战役也称让格朗-贝斯莱战役、贝斯莱战役或大富热雷战役。

en.s: The Battle of Mag Femen took place on 22 August 917 between the Vikings of the Uí Ímair, led by Ragnall, a grandson of Ímar, and the Irish of the Northern Uí Néill, led by Niall Glúndub, High King of Ireland. It was one of two battles involving the Uí Ímair that year, the other being the Battle of Confey, which occurred as a result of the Uí Ímair trying to retake the Kingdom of Dublin which they had lost in 902.

zh.s: 917年8月22日，伊瓦尔后裔维京人乌伊·伊迈尔部族（由伊瓦尔之孙拉格纳尔率领）与爱尔兰北乌伊·尼尔部族（由爱尔兰至高王尼尔·格伦杜布率领）在马格费门交战。这是乌伊·伊迈尔部族当年参加的两场战斗之一，另一场是康菲战役。乌伊·伊迈尔部族试图夺回他们在902年失去的都柏林王国，由此引发了康菲战役。

en.s: The Battle of the Standard, sometimes called the Battle of Northallerton, in which English forces repelled a Scottish army, took place on 22 August 1138 on Cowton Moor near Northallerton in Yorkshire. The Scottish forces were led by King David I of Scotland. The English were commanded by William of Aumale. King Stephen of England (fighting rebel barons in the south) had sent a small force (largely mercenaries), but the English army was mainly local militia and baronial retinues from Yorkshire and the north Midlands. Archbishop Thurstan of York had exerted himself greatly to raise the army, preaching that to withstand the Scots was to do God's work.

zh.s: 1138年8月22日，英军在约克郡诺萨勒顿附近的考顿荒原击退苏格兰军队，这场战斗有时也称诺萨勒顿战役。苏军由苏格兰国王大卫一世率领，英军由奥马勒的威廉指挥。英格兰国王斯蒂芬当时正在南方与叛乱男爵交战，只派出一支小部队（主要是雇佣兵）；英军主体是约克郡和中部北部地区的民兵及各地男爵的随从。约克大主教瑟斯坦竭力招募士兵，并宣讲抵御苏格兰人就是在履行上帝的事业。

en.s: The siege of Ascalon took place from 25 January to 22 August 1153, in the time period between the Second and Third Crusades, and resulted in the capture of the Fatimid Egyptian fortress by the Kingdom of Jerusalem. Ascalon was an important castle that was used by the Fatimids to launch raids into the Crusader kingdom's territory, and by 1153 it was the last coastal city in Palestine that was not controlled by the Crusaders.

zh.s: 1153年1月25日至8月22日，第二次和第三次十字军东征之间，耶路撒冷王国围攻并攻占了法蒂玛王朝在埃及的要塞阿斯卡隆。法蒂玛王朝曾以阿斯卡隆这座重要城堡为据点，袭击十字军王国领土。到1153年，它是巴勒斯坦最后一座不受十字军控制的沿海城市。

en.s: The Battle of Kōan, also known as the Second Battle of Hakata Bay, was the second attempt by the Mongol-led Yuan dynasty of China to invade Japan after their failed attempt seven years earlier at the Battle of Bun'ei. In the summer of 1281, the Yuan invaded with two large armies. The Japanese defenders were aided by a major storm which sank a sizeable portion of the Yuan fleets.

en.s: The siege of Jajce took place between 10 July and 22 August 1464, during the Ottoman conquest of Bosnia and Herzegovina, when an Ottoman army under Sultan Mehmed II made a new attempt to conquer Bosnia and take control of the strategic fortress of Jajce, south of Banja Luka, at the time under Hungarian control.

en.s: The Battle of Bosworth Field (or Battle of Bosworth) was the last significant battle of the Wars of the Roses, the civil war between the Houses of Lancaster and York that raged across England in the latter half of the 15th century. Fought on 22 August 1485, the battle was won by the Lancastrians. Their leader Henry Tudor, Earl of Richmond, by his victory became the first English monarch of the Tudor dynasty. His opponent, Richard III, the last king of the House of York, was killed in the battle.

zh.s: 博斯沃思原野战役（又称博斯沃思战役）是玫瑰战争中最后一场重要战役。这场内战发生在15世纪下半叶，交战双方是兰开斯特家族和约克家族。1485年8月22日，兰开斯特家族获胜。其领袖、里士满伯爵亨利·都铎因此成为都铎王朝的首位英格兰君主。他的对手、约克家族最后一位国王理查三世在战斗中阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Obertyn (August 22, 1531) was fought between Moldavian Voivode Petru Rareş and Polish forces under hetman Jan Tarnowski, in the town of Obertyn, south of the Dniester River, now in Ukraine. The battle ended with a Polish victory and the reconquest of Pokutia.

zh.s: 1531年8月22日，摩尔达维亚公国统治者彼得鲁·拉雷什与扬·塔尔诺夫斯基大将率领的波兰军队在奥贝尔廷镇交战。该镇位于第聂斯特河以南、今乌克兰境内。战斗以波兰获胜并重新征服波库蒂亚地区告终。

en.s: The siege of Nice occurred in 1543 and was part of the Italian War of 1542–46 in which Francis I and Suleiman the Magnificent collaborated as part of the Franco-Ottoman alliance against the Holy Roman Emperor Charles V, and Henry VIII of England. At that time, Nice was under the control of Charles III, Duke of Savoy, an ally of Charles V.

en.s: The Fettmilch uprising (German: Fettmilch-Aufstand) of 1614 was an antisemitic revolt in the Free imperial city of Frankfurt am Main, led by baker Vincenz Fettmilch. It was initially a revolt by the guilds against the mismanagement of the patrician-dominated city council, that culminated in the pillaging of the Frankfurter Judengasse (Jewish quarter) and the expulsion of Frankfurt's entire Jewish population, the worst outbreak of antisemitism in Germany between the fourteenth century and the 1930s.
en.n: Fettmilch uprising: Jews are expelled from Frankfurt, Holy Roman Empire, following the plundering of the Judengasse.

zh.s: 1614年，法兰克福自由帝国城市发生费特米尔希起义（德语：Fettmilch-Aufstand），这是一场由面包师文森茨·费特米尔希领导的反犹起义。起义最初是行会反对由贵族把持的市议会管理不善，最终演变为洗劫法兰克福犹太巷并驱逐全体犹太居民。这是德国从14世纪到20世纪30年代之间最严重的一次反犹事件。
zh.n: 费特米尔希起义：神圣罗马帝国法兰克福的犹太人在犹太巷被洗劫后遭到驱逐。

en.s: The Siege of Maastricht in 1632 was a military operation carried out by the Dutch Republic against the Spanish-held city of Maastricht during the Eighty Years’ War. Led by Frederick Henry, Prince of Orange, the Dutch forces sought to capture the strategically located city to gain control over an important crossing of the Meuse River and to weaken Spanish influence in the southern Netherlands.

The Cossack Hetmanate and Crimean Khanate combined forces against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth in a siege that lasted seven weeks.

en.s: The Quebec expedition (also known as the Walker expedition to Quebec) was a British attempt to attack French-held Quebec City in mid-1711 during Queen Anne's War, the North American theatre of the War of the Spanish Succession. It failed when seven troopships and one storeship were wrecked and 890 soldiers, sailors and women drowned in one of the worst naval disasters in British history.

zh.s: 魁北克远征又称沃克远征，是英国于1711年年中在安妮女王战争期间试图进攻法国控制的魁北克市的一次行动。安妮女王战争是西班牙王位继承战争在北美的战场。远征以失败告终：七艘运兵船和一艘补给船失事，890名士兵、水手和女性溺亡，成为英国历史上最严重的海难之一。

en.s: The Battle of Setauket (August 22, 1777) was a failed attack during the American Revolutionary War on a fortified Loyalist outpost in Setauket, Long Island, New York, by a force of Continental Army troops from Connecticut under the command of Brigadier General Samuel Holden Parsons. In an attempt to repeat the success of the earlier Meigs Raid against Sag Harbor, Parsons' force crossed Long Island Sound to attack the Loyalist position. Alerted by spies to the planned assault, Lieutenant Colonel Richard Hewlett strongly fortified the local Presbyterian church, surrounding it with a stockade and earthworks.

zh.s: 1777年8月22日，美国独立战争期间，塞缪尔·霍尔登·帕森斯准将率领一支来自康涅狄格州的大陆军，袭击纽约州长岛塞托基特的一处保皇派防御据点，但未能得手。帕森斯试图重现此前袭击萨格港的梅格斯突袭的成功，于是率部渡过长岛海峡，进攻保皇派阵地。理查德·休利特中校从间谍处得知进攻计划后，严密加固当地的长老会教堂，并在周围修筑栅栏和土垒。

en.s: The Battle of Staten Island was a raid by Continental Army troops under Major General John Sullivan against British forces on Staten Island on August 22, 1777, during the American Revolutionary War. After British Lieutenant General William Howe sailed with most of his army from New York in July, the Americans recognized that the British position on Staten Island was vulnerable, and planned an attack. Sullivan's raid was well-executed, but it suffered from a shortage of boats to effect the crossing, and one of its detachments was misled by its guide to the front of the enemy position rather than its rear.

zh.s: 1777年8月22日，美国独立战争期间，约翰·沙利文少将率领大陆军突袭斯塔滕岛上的英军。英国中将威廉·豪于7月率大部分军队乘船离开纽约后，美军认为英军在斯塔滕岛的阵地防守薄弱，遂计划进攻。沙利文的突袭执行得很顺利，但渡河船只不足，其中一支分队还被向导带到了敌军阵地正面，而非后方。

en.s: The siege of Fort Stanwix (also known as Fort Schuyler) began on August 2, 1777, and ended on August 22, 1777. Fort Stanwix, at the western end of the Mohawk River Valley, was a primary defense point for the Continental Army against the British and Indigenous forces aligned against them during the American Revolutionary War.

en.s: The action of 22 August 1795 was fought during the War of the First Coalition between a Royal Navy squadron of four frigates and a Batavian Navy squadron of two frigates and a cutter. Fought off the Norwegian coastal island of Eigerøya, then part of Denmark–Norway, the battle came about due to both squadrons' missions to protect their countries' trade routes to the Baltic Sea.

zh.s: 第一次反法同盟战争期间，1795年8月22日，英国皇家海军一支由4艘护卫舰组成的分舰队与巴达维亚海军一支由2艘护卫舰和1艘小型帆船组成的分舰队交战。战斗发生在挪威沿海的埃格尔岛附近，当时该岛属于丹麦—挪威。双方舰队都在执行保护本国波罗的海贸易航线的任务，因此发生交战。

en.s: The Battle of Theiningen took place in Germany on 22–23 August 1796 during the War of the First Coalition. A French division, led by Jean-Baptiste Bernadotte, repulsed an attempted encirclement, and fought a successful rearguard action, despite being outnumbered three-to-one, against an Austrian army led by Archduke Charles of Austria, allowing the French Army of Sambre and Meuse to retreat toward the Rhine.

zh.s: 第一次反法同盟战争期间，泰宁根战役于1796年8月22日至23日在德国发生。让-巴蒂斯特·贝尔纳多特率领的法军一个师击退了奥军的包围企图。尽管兵力只有对方三分之一，该师仍成功阻击了由奥地利大公查理率领的奥军，使桑布尔-默兹军团得以向莱茵河方向撤退。

en.s: João Maria Ferreira do Amaral (4 March 1803 – 22 August 1849) was a Portuguese military officer and politician. While he was governor of Macau, he was assassinated by several Chinese men, triggering the Battle of Passaleão between Portugal and China.

zh.s: 若昂·马里亚·费雷拉·杜·阿马拉尔（1803年3月4日—1849年8月22日）是葡萄牙军官和政治家。他担任澳门总督期间，被数名中国人刺杀，事件引发了中葡之间的Passaleão战役。

en.s: The Battle of Fort Ridgely was an early battle in the Dakota War of 1862. As the closest U.S. military post to the Lower Sioux Agency, the lightly fortified Fort Ridgely quickly became both a destination for refugees and a target of Dakota warbands after the attack at the Lower Sioux Agency.

en.s: The Battle of Guayacanes (Spanish: Batalla de Guayacanes de 1863) was a battle of the Dominican Restoration War that took place on August 22, 1863 and lasted several hours. A Spanish column advancing toward Santiago was engaged by Dominican forces near Guayacanes. Dominicans opened the battle with rifle fire; Spanish troops launched several assaults on Dominican defensive positions but were repelled, and the battle devolved into hand-to-hand combat with bayonets and machetes.

zh.s: 瓜亚卡内斯战役（西班牙语：Batalla de Guayacanes de 1863）是多米尼加复国战争中的一场战斗，于1863年8月22日发生，持续数小时。一支向圣地亚哥推进的西班牙纵队在瓜亚卡内斯附近遭到多米尼加军队迎击。多米尼加军先以步枪开火；西班牙军多次进攻多米尼加防线，但均被击退，战斗随后演变成双方用刺刀和砍刀进行的近身战。

en.s: The Battle of Złoczew, one of many clashes of the January Uprising, took place on 22 August 1863 near the town of Złoczew, which at that time belonged to Russian-controlled Congress Poland. A Polish insurgent unit under Edmund Taczanowski clashed with a detachment of the Imperial Russian Army and the battle resulted in Russian victory. The insurgents lost 5 men, and after the battle, Taczanowski ordered his party to withdraw towards Niechmirów.

zh.s: 1863年8月22日，一月起义期间的兹沃切夫战役在兹沃切夫镇附近爆发。当时该镇属于俄罗斯控制下的波兰会议王国。埃德蒙·塔查诺夫斯基率领的一支波兰起义军与俄罗斯帝国军队的一支分遣队交战，俄军获胜。起义军损失5人，战后塔查诺夫斯基下令部队向涅赫米鲁夫撤退。

en.t: Twelve states sign the first Geneva Convention
en.s: On August 22, 1864, representatives of twelve states signed the first Geneva Convention in Geneva, Switzerland. The treaty required care for wounded soldiers regardless of their nationality and protection for the medical personnel and facilities treating them. Later conventions revised and replaced the 1864 text.
en.n: This records the original 1864 convention, rather than the revised First Geneva Convention adopted in 1949.

zh.t: 12个国家签署第一部《日内瓦公约》
zh.s: 1864年8月22日，12个国家的代表在瑞士日内瓦签署第一部《日内瓦公约》。公约要求不分国籍救治伤兵，并保护为他们提供救治的医务人员和医疗设施。后来的公约对1864年文本进行了修订和替代。
zh.n: 此条记录1864年最初的公约，不是1949年修订通过的《日内瓦第一公约》。

en.s: The Geneva Conventions are a series of four international treaties (1949) and their three additional protocols that form the core of international humanitarian law. They establish legal standards for humanitarian treatment of non-combatants in war and protect people who are not or are no longer actively taking part in hostilities.

zh.s: 日内瓦公约由四项国际条约（1949年）及其三项附加议定书组成，是国际人道法的核心。公约确立了战争中人道对待非战斗人员的法律标准，并保护未曾或已不再积极参与敌对行动的人。

en.s: The Action of 22 August 1866 occurred during the Chincha Islands War near Funchal, on the island of Madeira, and was the final action of the war battle between Spanish and Chilean forces. The Chilean steamer Tornado was captured by the Spanish frigate Gerona, on 22 August 1866 off the island of Madeira. Tornado had arrived in Madeira under the command of Juan MacPherson, an English commander in service of the Chilean Navy.

zh.s: 1866年8月22日，钦查群岛战争期间，西班牙和智利军队在马德拉岛丰沙尔附近发生交战，这是战争中的最后一场战斗。智利蒸汽船“龙卷风号”在马德拉岛附近被西班牙护卫舰“赫罗纳号”俘获。“龙卷风号”此前在智利海军服役的英国指挥官胡安·麦克弗森率领下抵达马德拉岛。

en.s: The Natal Indian Congress was an organization that aimed to fight discrimination against Indians in South Africa. The Natal Indian Congress was started by Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, later known as the Mahatma. A constitution was put in place on 22 August 1894. During its formative years, the NIC introduced many early petitions for changes to proposed discrimatory legislations. It later allied itself with the African National Congress.

zh.s: 纳塔尔印度人大会是一个旨在反对南非歧视印度人的组织，由莫罕达斯·卡拉姆昌德·甘地（后来被尊称为圣雄甘地）创立。该组织于1894年8月22日制定章程。在成立初期，它多次请愿，要求修改拟议中的歧视性法律，后来与非洲人国民大会结盟。

en.s: The 1902 Turkestan earthquake (also known as the Artush or Kashgar earthquake) devastated Xinjiang, China, near the Kyrgyzstan border. It occurred on August 22, 1902, at 03:00:22 (09:00:22 local time) with an epicenter in the Tien Shan mountains. The thrust earthquake measured 7.7 on the moment magnitude scale (Mw) and had a depth of 18 km (11 mi).

zh.s: 1902年突厥斯坦地震又称阿图什地震或喀什地震，重创了中国新疆靠近吉尔吉斯斯坦边境的地区。地震发生于1902年8月22日03时00分22秒（当地时间09时00分22秒），震中位于天山山脉。此次逆冲型地震矩震级为7.7级，震源深度18公里。

en.t: The Cadillac Motor Company is founded
en.s: Cadillac Motor Car Division, or simply Cadillac (), is the luxury vehicle division of the American automobile manufacturer General Motors (GM). Its major markets are the United States, Canada, and China; Cadillac models are also distributed in 34 additional markets worldwide. Historically, Cadillac automobiles were at the top of the luxury field within the United States, often competing with Lincoln, but have been outsold by European luxury brands including BMW and Mercedes since the 2000s.

zh.t: 凯迪拉克汽车公司成立
zh.s: 凯迪拉克汽车部门（简称凯迪拉克）是美国汽车制造商通用汽车（GM）旗下的豪华汽车部门。其主要市场是美国、加拿大和中国，凯迪拉克车型还销往全球另外34个市场。从历史上看，凯迪拉克汽车曾位居美国豪华车市场前列，经常与林肯竞争；但自2000年代以来，销量已被宝马、梅赛德斯等欧洲豪华品牌超越。

en.s: The Korean Empire (Korean: 대한국; Hanja: 大韓國; lit. 'Great Korean State'), officially the Empire of Korea or Imperial Korea in English and commonly called Taehan Cheguk (Korean: 대한제국; Hanja: 大韓帝國; lit. 'Empire of Great Korea') in Korean, was a Korean monarchical state proclaimed in October 1897 by King Gojong of the Joseon dynasty. The empire lasted until the Japanese annexation of Korea in August 1910.
en.n: After the Japan–Korea Treaty of 1910 was signed on 22 August 1910, the Korean Empire was annexed.

zh.s: 大韩帝国（韩语：대한국；汉字：大韩国；意为“大韩国家”），英语正式名称为Korean Empire或Imperial Korea，韩语常称大韩帝国（Taehan Cheguk，韩语：대한제국；汉字：大韓帝國）。这是一个朝鲜君主制国家，由朝鲜王朝国王高宗于1897年10月宣布成立。帝国一直延续至1910年8月日本吞并朝鲜。
zh.n: 1910年8月22日签署《日韩合并条约》后，大韩帝国被吞并。

en.s: The Battle of Rossignol (22 August 1914) one of the first battles of the First World War, was part of the Battle of the Frontiers on the Western Front between the German and French armies. To counter the German invasion of Belgium, the French commander-in-chief, General Joseph Joffre, ordered an attack upon the centre of the German front.

en.s: The action of 22 August 1917, took place during the First World War, in the Ypres Salient on the Western Front as part of the Third Battle of Ypres. en.s: The Battle of Białystok was a battle of the Polish–Soviet War that took place near and within Białystok, Poland on August 22, 1920.The battle was between the 1st Infantry Regiment and withdrawing from the Warsaw remains of the RSFSR's Red Army 16th Army group and 3rd Army troops in the city of Białystok; the confusion caused by the Soviet forces chased, since the defeat at Warsaw, crushing into the forces stationed in Białystok caused complete breakdown Bolshevik forces. Within the city, fighting took all day and covered the entire Białystok. The individual parts of the city repeatedly passed from the Polish to the Russian hands and back.

zh.s: 比亚韦斯托克战役是波苏战争中的一场战斗，于1920年8月22日在波兰比亚韦斯托克及其附近发生。交战双方是第一步兵团，以及从华沙撤退的俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国红军第16集团军部队和驻扎在比亚韦斯托克的第3集团军部队。苏军在华沙战败后撤退，局势混乱；追击的波军冲击驻守比亚韦斯托克的苏军，导致布尔什维克部队彻底溃败。城内战斗持续了一整天，遍及全城，市内不同区域多次在波兰和俄军之间易手。

en.t: Michael Collins, Commander-in-chief of the Irish Free State Army, is shot dead in an ambush during the Irish Civil War
en.s: Michael Collins (Irish: Mícheál Ó Coileáin; 16 October 1890 – 22 August 1922) was an Irish revolutionary, soldier and politician who was a leading figure in the early-20th century struggle for Irish independence. zh.s: 迈克尔·柯林斯（爱尔兰语：Mícheál Ó Coileáin；1890年10月16日—1922年8月22日）是爱尔兰革命者、军人和政治家，也是20世纪初爱尔兰独立运动的重要人物。爱尔兰独立战争期间，他担任爱尔兰共和军（IRA）情报主管。他曾在爱尔兰共和国政府任内政部长，之后担任财政部长。

en.s: The "Battle of Candlestick", also called the "Battle of San Francisco" or simply the "Marichal–Roseboro brawl", was a bench-clearing brawl which took place on August 22, 1965, at Candlestick Park in San Francisco, California, United States. In what is considered to be one of the most violent on-field brawls in sports history, pitcher Juan Marichal of the San Francisco Giants hit catcher John Roseboro of the Los Angeles Dodgers on the head with a bat, opening a gash on Roseboro's head and starting a fourteen-minute brawl between the teams in the middle of a heated pennant race.

en.t: Sandinista guerrillas seize Nicaragua’s National Palace
en.s: On August 22, 1978, Sandinista National Liberation Front guerrillas led by Edén Pastora seized the National Palace in Managua while Nicaragua’s legislature was in session. en.s: Far Eastern Air Transport Flight 103 was a scheduled flight from Taiwan Taipei Songshan Airport to Kaohsiung International Airport that crashed on 22 August 1981, killing all 110 people on board. zh.s: 2015年冉冉凤凰世界锦标赛是由国际健美联合会（IFBB）力量之翼组织的女子职业健美比赛，与IFBB德克萨斯职业赛、NPC蒂姆·加德纳德克萨斯盛会和NPC全国赛同期举行。比赛于2015年8月20日至22日在美国德克萨斯州圣安东尼奥的君悦酒店举行。

en.s: The 2017 Iraq FA Cup final was the 26th final of the Iraq FA Cup as a club competition. The match was contested between Al-Zawraa and Naft Al-Wasat, at Al-Sinaa Stadium in Baghdad. It was played on 22 August 2017 to be the final match of the competition. Al-Zawraa made their record 17th appearance in the Iraq FA Cup final while Naft Al-Wasat, based in Najaf, became the first ever team from outside Baghdad to reach the final.

zh.s: 2017年伊拉克足总杯决赛是该俱乐部赛事的第26届决赛，由阿尔扎瓦拉对阵纳夫特·阿尔瓦萨特，比赛在巴格达的工业体育场举行。决赛于2017年8月22日进行，是该届赛事的最后一场比赛。阿尔扎瓦拉第17次闯入足总杯决赛，创下纪录；来自纳杰夫的纳夫特·阿尔瓦萨特则成为首支闯入决赛的巴格达以外球队。

en.s: NXT TakeOver XXX was a 2020 professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by WWE, held exclusively for wrestlers from the promotion's NXT brand division. en.s: The 2020 Northern Territory general election was held on 22 August 2020 to elect all 25 members of the Legislative Assembly in the unicameral Northern Territory Parliament. Members were elected through full preferential instant-runoff voting in single-member electorates, after the optional preferential voting system introduced for the 2016 election was abolished by the Electoral Legislation Amendment Act 2019 in April 2019.

en.s: The 2021 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship final was a hurling match played at Croke Park in Dublin on 22 August 2021 between Cork and Limerick, the culmination of the 2021 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship. It was the 134th final of that sport's primary competition, the All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship. Limerick won the game by 3–32 to 1–22 to claim their third All-Ireland title in four years.

zh.s: 2021年全爱尔兰高级盖尔式板棍球锦标赛决赛于2021年8月22日在都柏林克罗克公园举行，由科克队对阵利默里克队，是当年锦标赛的最后一场比赛。这是该项主要赛事的第134届决赛。利默里克以3比32对1比22获胜，在四年内第三次夺得全爱尔兰冠军。

en.s: The 2021 Yokohama mayoral election was held on 22 August 2021 to elect the next mayor of Yokohama. en.s: A by-election was held in the provincial riding of Waterford Valley in Newfoundland on August 22, 2024, to elect a new member of the Newfoundland and Labrador House of Assembly following the resignation of Liberal MHA and cabinet minister Tom Osborne. en.s: The 31st Sarajevo Film Festival took place between 15 and 22 August 2025 in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina. Black comedy film The Pavilion, by Bosnian filmmaker Dino Mustafić, opened the festival. A total of 227 films from 65 countries were shown in 22 festival programmes, out of which 50 films competed for the Heart of Sarajevo awards across four competition categories: feature, documentary, short, and student films.

The festival presented 75 feature-length films alongside a broad selection of events, including the New Nordic Films market, the Next Nordic Generation competition, and the Amanda Award ceremony scheduled for 16 August.
